findings.finding_text: Recovery flags every wake call as progress; a silent no-op wake suppresses the generic recovery re-enqueue and wedges the run.
findings.label: HIGH
findings.rationale: Wake returns boolean; only progressed wakes suppress generic recovery.

findings.finding_text: Wake failure path retains dispatchedTaskId; recovery re-fails an operator-retried run after restart and suppresses its re-execution.
findings.label: HIGH

findings.finding_text: DAG wake success branch force-resumes a run parked 'waiting' on an operator wait step, defeating the hold and wedging the loop.
findings.label: HIGH
findings.rationale: Hold preserved; held runs not re-enqueued; RED verified.

findings.finding_text: for_each and subflow processors persist pre-await snapshots; a mid-await dispatch wake is erased (same class as the collect fix).
findings.label: HIGH
findings.rationale: Merge + terminal/deleted guard applied; swarm verified synchronous, no window.

findings.finding_text: Hard-deleted run resurrected by post-await persist of the stale snapshot.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Null latest returns without writing, 3 processors.

findings.finding_text: Hard-deleted dispatched task parks the run forever; recovery has no path.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Recovery fails the step so DAG-stuck terminates.

findings.finding_text: requeueAfterWake give-up is log-only; zombie chains survive HMR/terminal runs.
findings.label: LOW

findings.finding_text: Recovery dispatch list truncated at 64 by uniqueIds cap.
findings.label: LOW

findings.finding_text: skip-dispatch test predicate matches any live run; no longer gates on parked dispatch.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Predicate gates on keyed dispatch step + created task.

findings.finding_text: Tests resolve tasks by createdTaskIds array position; keying swap undetectable.
findings.label: LOW

findings.finding_text: dispatch_delegation per-step keying untested; requeueAfterWake strand window not deterministically pinnable.
